result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: it provides Vendor defense and indemnity for third-party IP claims, legal violations, Vendor-caused Customer Data breaches, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct; limits Customer's indemnity to Customer-provided materials and legal violations; and includes standard claim procedures. The IP exclusions and remedies are consistent with the fallback and do not materially disturb unrelated terms. Drafting quality is reduced because the inserted paragraphs are not numbered even though Sections 9.3 and the new language refer to Sections 20.5 and 20.1(a), leaving facially unresolved cross-references. The data-breach trigger is also slightly narrower than ideal because it covers unauthorized access or disclosure but not expressly loss, alteration, or destruction of Customer Data.
